license_required.quote: Before being issued a license, an applicant may not engage in the practice of medicine in this state.

issuing_authority.value: Montana State Board of Medical Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Montana state board of medical examiners provided for in 2-15-1731.

name.value: Montana State Board of Medical Examiners
name.quote: "Board" means the Montana state board of medical examiners provided for in 2-15-1731.

type.quote: "Board" means the Montana state board of medical examiners provided for in 2-15-1731.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industry provided for in Title 2, chapter 15, part 17.

moral_character_required.quote: is of good moral character as determined by the board;

degree_required.value: Graduate of an approved medical school (doctor of medicine or doctor of osteopathy)
degree_required.quote: is a graduate of an approved medical school as defined in 37-3-102;

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME) or American Osteopathic Association (AOA)
accrediting_body.quote: "Approved medical school" means a school that either is accredited by the AOA or conforms to the education standards established by the LCME or the world health organization or successors for medical schools that meet standards established by the board by rule.

degree_level.quote: "Physician" means a person who holds a degree as a doctor of medicine or doctor of osteopathy and who has a valid license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state.

school_approval_basis.quote: "Approved medical school" means a school that either is accredited by the AOA or conforms to the education standards established by the LCME or the world health organization or successors

credential_pegged.quote: is a graduate of an approved medical school as defined in 37-3-102;

required.quote: has completed an approved residency program or, for an applicant who graduated from medical school prior to 2000, has had experience or training that the board has determined is at least the equivalent of an approved residency program;

experience_source.quote: has completed an approved residency program or, for an applicant who graduated from medical school prior to 2000, has had experience or training that the board has determined is at least the equivalent of an approved residency program;

kind.quote: "Approved residency" means a residency training program conforming to the standards for residency training established by the ACGME or successors or approved for residency training by the AOA.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Must pass all steps; also acceptable are FLEX, NBME, NBOME, Medical Council of Canada, or ECFMG exams depending on applicant's background.
exams.quote: has passed all of the steps of the United States medical licensing examination, the federation of state medical boards' federation licensing examination, or an examination offered by any of the following entities

exams.name: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) examination
exams.notes: Required only for graduates of foreign medical schools outside the US and Canada.
exams.quote: the educational commission for foreign medical graduates or its successors if the applicant is a graduate of a foreign medical school outside of the United States and Canada;

available.quote: The board may enter into agreements with other states for the purposes of mutual recognition of licensing standards and licensing of physicians and emergency care providers from other states under the terms of a mutual recognition agreement.

requirements.value: Reciprocity available through mutual recognition agreements with other states, and through the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact which provides an expedited licensure pathway for eligible physicians.
requirements.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions joining in the compact

exists.quote: "Board" means the Montana state board of medical examiners provided for in 2-15-1731.

national_certification.value: National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME); National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners (NBOME); Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG); Medical Council of Canada
national_certification.quote: the national board of medical examiners or its successors; the national board of osteopathic medical examiners or its successors; the medical council of Canada or its successors; the educational commission for foreign medical graduates or its successors

national_association.value: American Osteopathic Association (AOA); Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME)
national_association.quote: "AOA" means the American osteopathic association. ... "ACGME" means the accreditation council for graduate medical education.

regulatory_model.quote: Before being issued a license, an applicant may not engage in the practice of medicine in this state.

credential_type.quote: The department may issue two kinds of licenses under the board's seal, a physician's license and a resident license.

is_mandatory.quote: Before being issued a license, an applicant may not engage in the practice of medicine in this state.

title_protection.quote: may not use the title "M.D.", "D.O.", or any word or abbreviation to indicate or to induce others to believe that they are engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of persons afflicted with disease, injury, or defect of body or disorder of mind except to the extent and under the conditions expressly provided by the law under which they are licensed.

scope_protection.quote: If a person who does not possess a license to practice medicine in this state under this chapter and who is not exempt from the licensing requirements of this chapter performs acts constituting the practice of medicine, the person is practicing medicine in violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee is mentally or physically unable to safely engage in the practice of medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is mentally or physically unable to safely engage in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured a license to practice medicine by fraud or misrepresentation or through mistake.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has procured a license to practice medicine by fraud or misrepresentation or through mistake

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has been declared incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction and has not later been lawfully declared competent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been declared incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction and has not later been lawfully declared competent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has a condition that impairs the person's intellect or judgment to the extent that the condition incapacitates the person for the safe performance of professional duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has a condition that impairs the person's intellect or judgment to the extent that the condition incapacitates the person for the safe performance of professional duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has practiced medicine with a suspended or revoked license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has practiced medicine with a suspended or revoked license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has had a license to practice medicine suspended or revoked by any licensing authority for reasons other than nonpayment of fees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had a license to practice medicine suspended or revoked by any licensing authority for reasons other than nonpayment of fees;

disciplinary_grounds.description: While under probation has violated the terms of probation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: while under probation has violated the terms of probation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a physician or surgeon to provide written informed consent to breast cancer patients constitutes unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a physician or surgeon to provide written informed consent as provided in subsection (1) constitutes unprofessional conduct.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of or the attempt to or the holding of oneself out as being able to diagnose, treat, or correct human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities, whether physical or mental, by any means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities, including electronic and technological means such as telemedicine.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of or the attempt to or the holding of oneself out as being able to diagnose, treat, or correct human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities, whether physical or mental, by any means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities, including electronic and technological means such as telemedicine.

methods_authorized.quote: by any means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities, including electronic and technological means such as telemedicine.

license_status_types.quote: The department may issue two kinds of licenses under the board's seal, a physician's license and a resident license.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must pass the ECFMG examination and must have graduated from a foreign medical school outside the US and Canada.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: the educational commission for foreign medical graduates or its successors if the applicant is a graduate of a foreign medical school outside of the United States and Canada;

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: For physicians providing written certification of a debilitating medical condition, audio-only telemedicine is not permitted unless the physician has previously established a physician-patient relationship through an in-person encounter.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: For physicians providing written certification of a debilitating medical condition pursuant to 16-12-509, the term does not include audio-only communication unless the physician has previously established a physician-patient relationship through an in-person encounter.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions joining in the compact

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board shall establish a medical assistance program to assist and rehabilitate licensees who are subject to the jurisdiction of the board and who are found to be physically or mentally impaired by habitual intemperance or the excessive use of addictive drugs, alcohol, or any other drug or substance or by mental illness or chronic physical illness.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: may, upon order of the board, include requiring the person to submit to a physical examination or a mental examination, or both, by a physician or physicians selected by the board or the board's representative if the board considers that the evaluation is in the best interests of the public.
